code='''from collections import deque


def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for sr in range(h):
        for sc in range(w):
            if grid[sr][sc] == 8 or (sr, sc) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(sr, sc)])
            seen.add((sr, sc))
            cells = []
            while q:
                r, c = q.popleft()
                cells.append((r, c))
                for nr, nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] != 8 and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                        seen.add((nr,nc))
                        q.append((nr,nc))
            colored = [(r,c) for r,c in cells if grid[r][c] not in (0,8)]
            if not colored:
                continue
            r0 = min(r for r,c in cells); r1 = max(r for r,c in cells)
            c0 = min(c for r,c in cells); c1 = max(c for r,c in cells)
            pr0 = min(r for r,c in colored); pr1 = max(r for r,c in colored)
            pc0 = min(c for r,c in colored); pc1 = max(c for r,c in colored)
            ph, pw = pr1-pr0+1, pc1-pc0+1
            pattern = [[grid[pr0+i][pc0+j] for j in range(pw)] for i in range(ph)]
            for r,c in cells:
                out[r][c] = pattern[(r-r0)%ph][(c-c0)%pw]
    return out
'''
p=base/'task-ea2ed5df.py'
p.write_text(code)
print(p)
